enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Physical Sheltering +22: +22 Enhancement bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Fortification +104%: +104% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Parrying +4: +4 Insight bonus to Armor Class, +4 Insight bonus to Saves.
Freedom of Movement: This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.
Lost Purpose: This item is missing some parts that made it unique. Perhaps you can fix that at a Cannith Repurposing Station.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
